dct_title_s: Storm Water Collection System Points - City of Newton
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This coverage contains point features such as manholes, catchbasins, ditch ends, dry wells, pipe junctions, pipe ends and outfalls which comprise part of the storm water collection network for the city of Newton. Line features such as pipes and ditches are contained in the Storm Water Collection System Lines data layer.

Purpose: This layer is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers and planners for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data. This layer may provide a basemap for layers related to urban planning, public works, or utilities purposes (including defining boundaries, managing assets and facilities, integrating attribute databases with geographic features, spatial analysis, and presentation output.

Supplemental information: This data layer is not presently being maintained; however, the Department of Public Works is attempting to start a project to field check the drain infrastructure and resolve some of the many discrepancies.
